summary: 修饰名词的从句：先行词是人用 who/whom/that，是物用 which/that，关系词在从句中作定语用 whose。

rules.title: 先行词是人：who / that（作宾语可用 whom / who / that）
rules.detail: 关系词指代先行词 the girl，在从句中作主语，后面直接跟谓语动词。注意：用了关系词就不能再重复出现 he/she/it 等代词。

examples.en: The girl who is wearing a red coat is my sister.
examples.zh: 穿红外套的那个女孩是我妹妹。

examples.en: The man that you met yesterday is our new teacher.
examples.zh: 你昨天遇见的那个人是我们的新老师。

rules.title: 先行词是物：which / that
rules.detail: The book which/that lies on the desk is mine. 关系词在从句中作主语或宾语；作宾语时关系词可省略。

examples.en: I like the photos which were taken in Yunnan.
examples.zh: 我喜欢那些在云南拍的照片。

examples.en: The song (that) we heard just now is very popular.
examples.zh: 我们刚才听的那首歌非常流行。

rules.title: whose 表所属 + 只能用 that 的情况
rules.detail: whose + 名词 表示「……的」；先行词被序数词、最高级、the only、all 等修饰时，关系词只用 that。

examples.en: I know the boy whose father is a policeman.
examples.zh: 我认识那个爸爸是警察的男孩。

examples.en: This is the best movie that I have ever seen.
examples.zh: 这是我看过的最好的电影。

pitfalls: 从句谓语单复数看先行词：❌ The books which is on the desk... → ✓ The books which are on the desk...
that 和 which 混用限制：介词后只用 which（the house in which...），不能用 that
关系词重复：❌ The book that I bought it is good. → ✓ The book that I bought is good.（关系词已替代 it）

questions.stem: The teacher ___ is standing there is our headmaster.
questions.explain: 先行词 the teacher 是人，且在从句中作主语，用 who。

questions.stem: I still remember the factory ___ we visited ten years ago.
questions.explain: 先行词 factory 是物，从句中 visit 缺宾语，用 which/that。

questions.stem: Do you know the girl ___ mother is a nurse?
questions.explain: 从句中 mother 前缺定语「……的」，用 whose。

questions.stem: This is the most exciting film ___ I have ever watched.
questions.explain: 先行词被最高级修饰，关系词只能用 that。

questions.stem: The photos ___ were taken in Beijing are beautiful. (关系代词，指物)
questions.explain: 先行词 photos 是物且在从句中作主语，用 which/that。

questions.stem: The boy ___ is reading under the tree is my brother. (关系代词，指人)
questions.explain: 先行词 the boy 是人且作从句主语，用 who/that。

questions.stem: The shoes which I bought it yesterday are too small.
questions.explain: 关系词 which 已经替代先行词在从句中作宾语，不能再出现 it。

questions.stem: 正在唱歌的那个女孩是我的好朋友。（翻译整句）
answer: the girl who is singing is my good friend.
the girl that is singing is my good friend.
questions.explain: 先行词 the girl 是人，用 who/that 引导定语从句。

questions.stem: 这就是我们去年种的那棵树。（翻译整句）
answer: this is the tree that we planted last year.
this is the tree which we planted last year.
questions.explain: 先行词 the tree 是物，关系词 that/which 作从句宾语，也可省略。
